source.title: PE Life Reinsurers — Earnings Call Review FY2023–2026

summary: Tone has drifted down for four of five. Only Athene is labelled Good (+0.50). Brookfield, KKR, Corebridge and F&G are Average, and Brookfield, Corebridge and F&G are at or near their lows since 2023.

Spread compression is the common thread, with different measures. Athene net spread went from 166bp (Q2'23) to a 97bp low (Q1'26) and 114bp in Q2'26, against a 120–125bp guide. Brookfield core annuity spread about 180bp vs 225bp a quarter earlier. Corebridge guides compression through end-2026. F&G fixed income yield fell 16bp in Q1'26. KKR calls sector ROEs structurally low.

Alternatives and VII keep missing. Athene alts 6% in Q1'26 against an 11% assumption; Corebridge expects VII below its 8–9% target through 2026; F&G alts $49M in Q2'26 against a 12% assumption; KKR reports a mark-versus-cash gap of $600M+ year to date that it expects to convert in 2027–28.

Liability-side competition is now the explicit constraint. Apollo calls pricing irrational and counts 36 asset managers entering retail annuities; KKR is allocating less capital to insurance; Brookfield is a self-described price taker. Corebridge and F&G retail sales fell about 41% and 34% YoY respectively in Q2'26.

Growth is still strong where capital is cheapest. Athene inflows were $22B in Q2'26 ($42B in H1, $85B target); KKR and Athene both lean on sidecars (Ivy about $6B dry powder, ADIP $4.4B in the quarter); F&G added the Fort Green sidecar in Aug 2025.

Bermuda 15% CIT is almost absent from the calls. The only direct remark is Brookfield's Q2'23 comment that it would be immaterial. The live regulatory topic is Cayman and non-reciprocal-jurisdiction scrutiny (UK PRA, Japan, NAIC proposals) raised by Apollo; F&G sold F&G Life Re (Bermuda) to Ancient effective 1 Mar 2026.
Earnings quality is deteriorating at Brookfield. Q2'26 six-month net loss of $453M on inflation-derivative and equity marks, with corporate borrowings up to $2.65B from $0.63B.

Corebridge and F&G are the weakest on core earnings. Corebridge APTOI fell 21% YoY in Q2'26 with all three insurance segments down, leverage at 33.0%, and a pending merger with Equitable. F&G ANE $85M (-17% YoY) and ROE 8%.
PRT has stopped being a growth story at Apollo. Zero PRT inflows in Q2'26 and YTD; management calls recent PRT spreads poor. Corebridge and F&G still write PRT but at lower or lumpy volumes.

Structural events to track. Corebridge–Equitable merger (close by year-end), BN/BWS simplification approved 16 July, Just Group closed 1 April, FNF’s distribution of about 12% of F&G, NAIC CLO capital charges (about -10 RBC points at F&G).

Evidence quality varies. Apollo, BWS Q2'25 onwards and part of KKR were read on primary or full transcripts; Apollo Q1'23–Q1'25, KKR, Corebridge and all F&G calls rest on truncated or AI-summarised third-party text, and Corebridge Q2'23 is release only. Earnings figures were not re-checked against releases except where the sections say so.
